site.name: recaptcha-next
site.description: Google reCAPTCHA v3 for React and Next.js: client token generation and server-side verification.

hero.title: reCAPTCHA v3 for Next.js, built for Server Actions.
hero.lede: A client field that keeps a fresh token in a hidden input, and a server function that checks it with Google. Typed results, one script per site key, MIT licensed.

features.title: Read the token from FormData
features.text: The token travels in the form, so an action verifies it with getRecaptchaToken and verifyRecaptcha, and gets a typed result instead of an exception.

features.title: Load Google only when needed
features.text: With lazy, the script waits until the form is near the viewport, and tokens refresh before they expire.

features.title: One script per site key
features.text: Fields with the same key share a script across mounts and client-side navigation. Different site keys initialize independently.

features.title: Missing configuration fails closed
features.text: Only explicit development and test modes may skip a missing secret. Production and unknown runtime modes require verification.

collections.label: Examples
collections.lede: Forms you can copy and adapt.
